notes.title: PowerNap can now AUTOMATICALLY update your PC games while your sleep!
notes.content:
PowerNap can now automatically wake up your PC at a set time each day, update all of your games, and then put your computer back to sleep. This is perfect for automatically updating your PC games while you sleep or go to work. This is very similar to what most modern gaming consoles and smartphones do, and we're really happy that we could make it work on PC.

I want to thank our amazing Beta testers for the feedback that helped us build this new feature. Our goal is to make sure that all of your PC games are updated as much as possible, all of the time, so that you never have to wait. With your help, we will make the best app possible. There is still time to join the Beta tester community by emailing: TastyDeliciousGames@gmail.com

We are going to release the app on June 4, which is in just TWO WEEKS! If you support our mission, please wishlist PowerNap today! The app will cost $3.99.

notes.title: Listening to our Beta testers' feedback
notes.content:
[h2]Our mission and you[/h2]
Our mission on PowerNap is to make updating your PC games easier than ever before.  Even during our closed Beta, we have read [b]every single e-mail[/b] that you guys sent to us.  Working together with you, the community, is going to make PowerNap more powerful than ever!

[h2]More options[/h2]
The most common request that we've gotten so far is to add more options for what PowerNap should do when your uploads & downloads are finished. Today, we are excited to announce [b]six new options[/b] for this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39832714/9b45682dd185a816524bb600bdfcb536db25d035.png[/img]

Please note: the "Exit All Launchers" and "Exit Launchers and Sleep" options currently only exit launchers that were opened through PowerNap. These options also close PowerNap. 

[h2]Join the closed Beta today![/h2]
Want to join the closed Beta, and help give us feedback? Simply email TastyDeliciousGames@gmail.com, and request a Beta key! You can also use that address to send us feedback directly, and we truly look forward to hearing from you.
